record.original_question: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n be an integer greater than 1, and let k[n] = k[x1, ..., xn] be the polynomial algebra in n variables. Let Aut*_k k[n] be the subgroup of polynomial k-automorphisms sigma of k[n] whose Jacobian determinant det(D_i(sigma(x_j))) is 1, where D_i = partial/partial x_i. Let T be the diagonal torus of volume-preserving automorphisms sigma = diag(t1, ..., tn) such that sigma(x_i) = t_i x_i and t1 ... tn = 1. A nonzero locally nilpotent derivation D of k[n] is a root vector of Aut*_k k[n] with respect to T when there is a nontrivial character chi: T -> G_m such that sigma o D o sigma^(-1) = chi(sigma)D for every sigma in T; chi is the corresponding root. What are all roots and all root vectors of Aut*_k k[n] with respect to T?

evidence.quote: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0.
Let k[n] := k[x1, . . . , xn] be the polynomial algebra in variables x1, . . . , xn over k, and let n > 1.
Aut*_k k[n] := {sigma in Aut_k k[n] | det(Di(sigma(xj)))_{1<=i,j<=n} = 1}
T := {sigma := diag(t1, . . . , tn) in Aut*_k k[n] | sigma(xi) = tixi, ti in k, product_i ti = 1}.
Problem 1.1. Find all roots and root vectors of Aut*_k k[n] with respect to T.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$, let $n>1$ be an integer, and let $k^{[n]}=k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be the polynomial algebra in $n$ variables over $k$. Define
$$\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]} := \{\sigma\in \mathrm{Aut}_k k^{[n]}\mid \det(D_i(\sigma(x_j)))_{1\le i,j\le n}=1\},$$
where $D_i=\partial/\partial x_i$. Let $T$ be the diagonal torus
$$T:=\{\sigma=\mathrm{diag}(t_1,\dots,t_n)\in \mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}\mid \sigma(x_i)=t_i x_i,\; t_i\in k^*,\; t_1\cdots t_n=1\}.$$
A nonzero locally nilpotent derivation $D$ of $k^{[n]}$ is called a root vector of $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}$ with respect to $T$ if there exists a nontrivial character $\chi:T\to \mathbb{G}_m$ such that $\sigma\circ D\circ \sigma^{-1}=\chi(\sigma)D$ for every $\sigma\in T$; the character $\chi$ is then called the corresponding root.

Determine all roots and all root vectors of $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}$ with respect to $T$.
artifact.category_tag: Affine Cremona group / locally nilpotent derivations
artifact.status_search_result: The problem (a question of Popov on roots of the affine Cremona group with respect to the diagonal torus) was solved by A. Liendo (arXiv:1010.4034, 2010; published in Transformation Groups, 2011). The root vectors are exactly the locally nilpotent derivations of the form $x^\alpha\,\partial/\partial x_i$, where $x^\alpha$ is a monomial not depending on $x_i$; the corresponding roots are the associated characters of $T$.

status_evidence.snippet: The root vectors of the subgroup of volume preserving automorphisms in the affine Cremona group, with respect to the diagonal torus, are exactly the locally nilpotent derivations x^α(∂/∂x_i), where x^α is any monomial not depending on x_i.
status_evidence.claim: Liendo determined all root vectors and roots, answering Popov's question.
